tagline.en: New win and loss effects everywhere, plus How to play in every game.
tagline.id: Efek menang dan kalah baru di semua game, plus Cara main di tiap game.

items.en: Win in any game: coins burst and your multiplier pops up. Lose: the board shakes.
items.id: Menang di game apa pun: koin berhamburan dan multiplier muncul. Kalah: papan bergetar.

items.en: Tap ? next to any game title for a 3-step How to play.
items.id: Ketuk ? di samping judul game untuk Cara main 3 langkah.

items.en: Smoother springs in Tower, Sweet and Limbo.
items.id: Gerakan lebih halus di Tower, Sweet, dan Limbo.

items.en: Cross the Road is harder: cars come more often.
items.id: Cross the Road lebih sulit: mobil lebih sering datang.
